name: SNAKE
description: Eat, grow longer, and never bite your own tail. Speeds up as you go.
Slide the tiles, merge matching numbers, and hunt down the 2048 tile.

name: WORD GUESS
description: Six tries to crack a five-letter word. Green is right, yellow is close.

name: CONNECT FOUR
description: Drop your discs and line up four in a row. Share one screen or beat the CPU.
